text:
Maya (ProdMkt): Quick sync — landing copy pass for tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) before next week's webinar. Need headlines + 2 CTAs and inbound routing mapping.
Ava (Growth): I like 'deploy anywhere, run everywhere' but maybe too infra-y. Suggest 'Same API. Any deployment. Predictable inference.'
Ruben (Content): First draft headlines:
- Hosted: Start in minutes with our hosted API — pay-as-you-go, instant keys
- Dedicated: Predictable throughput for production — reserved GPU pools
- Private: Full control for regulated workloads — VPC + KMS
Sam (DemandGen): For webinar signup flow: primary CTA -> Register (webinar). Secondary -> Start free (free credits). Tertiary -> Request a demo (enterprise). UTM plan: ?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web
Maya (ProdMkt): Routing rules: webinar registrants -> webinar nurture (Sam). High-intent demo requests -> SDR queue (Lucy). Try/free clicks -> self-serve trial funnel.
Lucy (SDR): How do we mark 'high-intent'? Proposal: require 'company_size' + 'use_case' + demo CTA click. We'll add hidden field intent=demo on demo CTA. :+1:
Ava (Growth): Benchmark narrative — show 3 metrics: median latency at 2k toks, cost per 1k tokens vs baseline, and 99th latency SLO. Hero stat idea: 'Production economics: ~35% lower per-token cost vs baseline'. Need verification numbers from infra team.
Ruben (Content): Microcopy under CTAs:
- Hosted: Free credits & instant API key
- Dedicated: SLA-backed capacity & reserved throughput
- Private: VPC-deployable, KMS and audit logs
Maya (ProdMkt): Webinar landing specifics: primary button 'Register' (form), secondary 'Start free' (signup flow), tertiary 'Request a demo' (enterprise contact). Map clicks to flows and set GA events.
Sam (DemandGen): UTM snippet to use:
`?utm_source=launch_post&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content=cta_register`
I'll push to GA4 and ensure goal events.
Lucy (SDR): I'll create HubSpot segment 'webinar_registrants' and 'high_intent_demo' using hidden intent param and form responses. Will wire notifications to #sales-leads.
deploy-bot: Draft landing copy published to staging: /staging/landing/tri-mode-copy-v3 — preview link: https://staging.redwood.ai/tri-mode
Maya (ProdMkt): Action items: Ruben — copy by EOD. Sam — UTM + GA events. Lucy — HubSpot segments + SDR routing. Ava — A/B test hero headline variants. Staging review scheduled Thursday 10am PT. :rocket:
